Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: At step 11, WebSurfer decided to search within Ensembl Release 102 (November 2020) despite the target date being 20/10/2020. This ignored the temporal constraint; the correct most recent release on that date was 101 (August 2020). This misalignment led to providing the wrong (release-102) FTP directory instead of the correct release-101 GFF3 file URL.
